posts.raw_content:
Good evening,

1.	Stickies 

As we approach the midterms and the next two years of Trump's current term, I would like to solicit feedback on what you want to see more of, or less of, as far as stickies go.  Would you like stickies to be rotated out at a faster or slower pace? Would you like more positive stickies, or more "the democrats are being nuts and this is what our world is coming to" stickies? 

I'll tell you what I currently do: I look through new posts for potential stickies and try to keep a mix of both. If I see news that I think is important and it hasn't been posted yet, I'll make sure it gets posted. 

I often see users complain that most stickies come from Kek, Orlando, or certain other users. The reality is simple: they post a lot, so they get stickied a lot. The opportunity to get stickied is proportional to the amount of quality content you post. Some users have also figured out what makes a good sticky: 
Relevant news 
Formatted correctly 
Current 
Titled properly 
A YouTube post likely won’t be stickied because it won’t embed

 (A ping to me is always helpful, but it's not a guarantee of feedback or a sticky.)

2.	Moderation 

As a moderation team, we've been somewhat too hands-off when it comes to bans and comment removals. Recently, we've allowed too much participation from brand-new users and users with alternative motivations, leading to discussion that isn't always organic.  Do you think we've become too permissive, or do you prefer our current approach? If changes are needed, where do you think the right balance is between keeping discussion open and maintaining quality?


3.	Mods 

Mods are gay, but as all gays know, I need some more good men (or women if you're hormonally stable and not a child killer).  If we want to get through the next few months and into the next few years, we need trusted mods drawn from trusted users. You don't have to be the most active person here, but I do have to trust you.  If you're interested in dedicating some time to the community and the country, send me a PM.  

 If you have feedback on any of the topics above, just reply and we can discuss it further throughout this thread.   The goal here is to make sure the community stays active, informed, and worth participating in as we head into the midterms. Let me know what we're doing right, what we're doing wrong, and what you'd like to see change. 


Thank you all for being here and thank you for your feedback.
